# Michael Hrubý — Portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Michael Hrubý, a Computer Science student at Masaryk University and Junior System Administrator at Lexical Computing CZ.

This website presents Michael's experience, education, technical skills, and selected software and game-localisation projects. The primary content is available in English and Czech.

## Pages

- [English portfolio](https://michael-hruby.eu/): Experience, education, skills, and projects in English.
- [Czech portfolio](https://michael-hruby.eu/cs): Czech version of the portfolio.
- [Sitemap](https://michael-hruby.eu/sitemap.xml): URLs published by the site.

## About Michael Hrubý

- Computer Science student at Masaryk University in Brno, Czech Republic.
- Junior System Administrator at Lexical Computing CZ.
- Interests include web development, game development, self-hosting, systems administration, and open-source software.

## Selected projects

- [Czech localisation for RealRTCW](https://github.com/GalactusCZ/realrtcw-czech): Czech translation, subtitles, menus, and dubbing work for RealRTCW.
- [Personal website source](https://github.com/GalactusCZ/main-page): Source code for this Astro portfolio.
